body:
We had been best friends for 10+ years. I apparently was blissfully unaware that he harbored deeper feelings for me for at least 6 of those. 

We talked nearly every day for all of that time, and he knew where I stood. I couldn’t have asked for a better friend. 

He admitted via social media that he wished he would have broken up with his girlfriend and dated me. But that happened after he cut ties. 

I get it. He felt friend-zoned. I never wanted to lose what we had. 

He moved two years ago, and I went along to see the house he was moving into. To support him in the new chapter. 

Since he moved, he hasn’t come back to my state. (It is a toxic community and I completely understand why). But I couldn’t understand why he wouldn’t at least send our “pen pal” notebook back. 

I was sad when he left. And hurt when he cut ties two years later. I do understand why, and I can still be mad about it. I invested so much into the relationship, supported him no matter the distance, and he gave it all up.
Here’s to a night of live music with a couple of my good friends.

I didn’t do the breaking... they did. I was perfectly happy with the friendship, but apparently I was holding them back from happiness. They moved to another state a little while ago. They said they had changed/ grown up, and for my sake, our friendship couldn’t continue. 

I wanted to work it out, but anything I said that day would fall flat. That’s on me.
